questions.q: When is the front-desk inbox checked?
questions.gold: Weekdays at 7:30 a.m. and 3 p.m. Eastern

questions.q: A client wants a routine appointment for a dog weighing exactly 40 kg. May you book it yourself?
A client wants an appointment for a 42 kg dog. Who must book it?
A client confirms a spay surgery 30 hours before drop-off. May you keep the slot?
questions.gold: No; it goes back on the waitlist (only dental cleanings may be kept)

questions.q: A caller says their dog ate rat poison. What do you tell them, and what do you do yourself, in what order?
questions.gold: Tell them to drive in immediately; phone the emergency line (207) 555-0143 yourself; then text Dana

questions.q: An account has a balance of exactly $200. Does it go on Friday's list for Dana?
May the owner, Martin Kell, be copied on a client email?
Is sending Dana the balances list at exactly 9:00 a.m. on Friday on time?
When is the residence inbox checked?
A resident asks you to extend a short stay by exactly 7 nights. May you do it yourself?
A resident hosts an overnight guest for 6 nights in the same month. How much do they pay in total?
A departing resident's deposit is exactly €600. May you refund it yourself?
A fire alarm goes off. What do you tell residents, and what do you do yourself, in what order?
questions.gold: Tell them to exit by stairway B; call the caretaker at 04 72 55 01 38 yourself; then text Claire

questions.q: May the director, Hélène Brisset, be copied on a routine rent reminder? And on an exclusion email?
questions.gold: No for a routine reminder; yes for an exclusion

questions.q: Rent has been unpaid for exactly 5 days on Monday morning. Does it go on Claire's list?
Is sending Claire the unpaid-rent list at exactly 10:00 on Monday on time?
When is the studio inbox checked?
questions.gold: Every day at 8 a.m. and 6 p.m.

questions.q: A member asks you to book them 2 classes on the same day. May you do it yourself?
A member asks you to book 3 classes on the same day. May you do it without approval?
A member cancels exactly 3 hours before class starts. Is a session deducted?
A member cancels 2 hours before class; the instructor was not changed. Is a session deducted?
A member has used 4 sessions of a 10-session pass and wants a refund. Is it allowed, and who processes it?
questions.gold: Yes; manager Jung Sua processes it (you only tell the member to fill in the refund form)

questions.q: A member is injured during class. What do you tell the instructor, and what do you do yourself, in what order?
questions.gold: Tell the instructor not to move the member; call 119 yourself; then text Jung Sua at 010-5550-2741

questions.q: May the CEO, Park Dohyun, be cc'd on a member email?
When is the orders inbox checked?
An order totals exactly R$ 800,00. May you accept it on your own?
A customer not on the Cesta Semanal plan orders exactly R$ 150,00. Is there a delivery fee?
An order has been late for exactly 2 hours. Does the customer get the 10% coupon?
A customer received a damaged product and wants a refund. Who does the refund, and what must the customer do?
questions.gold: Juliana Prates does the refund; the customer must send a photo to qualidade@raizverde.com.br within 24 hours of delivery

questions.q: The customer is not home. What do you do, and may you give the customer the driver's phone number?
questions.gold: Ask the driver to call the central at (31) 5555-0192; no, never give the driver's phone

questions.q: What exact sentence must end every order confirmation?
questions.gold: "Frutas maduras podem variar de cor e tamanho."
accept: frutas maduras podem variar de cor e tamanho

questions.q: Is sending Thiago the cancelled-orders report at 11:00 sharp on Thursday on time?
